paper_title: Robust cosmological constraints on axion-like particles
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (approximate lower boundary of BBN+Planck excluded region)
notes: Cosmological (BBN + Planck Neff) constraint on ALP-photon coupling g_phi_gamma in the keV-GeV mass range. Main results shown in mphi-tauphi and mphi-gphi_gamma planes (Figs 4-6). Excluded region is a closed 2D region rather than a single line, so extracted values are approximate boundary points read from Fig 6 (right panel) for the standard cosmological scenario. Not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density applies. Lifetime relation tau = 64pi/(m^3 g^2).
